DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC)

The liver function tests show a significant elevation in Alkaline Phosphatase and Bilirubin, which is highly characteristic of a cholestatic liver disease. While I need to confirm your age and if you have seen a rash or itching, these findings strongly point to an autoimmune condition affecting the bile ducts rather than a viral or obstructive cause.
